Add QC flags to a master audio table

Source: R/01_scan_audio.R
pam_add_qc.Rd

Add QC flags to a master audio table

Usage

pam_add_qc(master, cfg)

Arguments

master

data.table from pam_parse_filenames() joined with pam_audio_info().

cfg

A pam_config object (uses qc$gap_tolerance_s and audio$min_duration_s).

Value

master with end_time, truncated, short, duplicate, gap_s, gap_before, overlap_before and qc_pass. Sorted by grid and start time.

Details

Gaps are measured between the end of one file and the start of the next within a grid. qc_pass requires a valid name, a readable and untruncated file, and no duplicate; short files and gaps are reported but do not fail QC. Truncation checks apply to PCM WAV files (where bit depth is non-NA).

Examples

ex <- pam_example_project()
cfg <- ex$cfg
master <- pam_parse_filenames(ex$files, cfg$filenames$pattern, cfg$filenames$timezone)
master <- merge(master, pam_audio_info(ex$files), by = "file_path")
master <- pam_add_qc(master, cfg)
as.data.frame(master)[, c("file_name", "gap_s", "qc_pass")]
#>                   file_name gap_s qc_pass
#> 1 G0059_20260405_183000.wav    NA    TRUE
#> 2 G0059_20260405_183002.wav     0    TRUE
#> 3 G0059_20260405_183004.wav     0    TRUE
#> 4 G0110_20260406_060000.wav    NA    TRUE
#> 5 G0110_20260406_060002.wav     0    TRUE
#> 6 G0110_20260406_060004.wav     0    TRUE
